decisions.reason: The PETG blank is a low-cost addition to the established thermoforming range and once had its own page, so despite its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 management would keep it rather than admit the launch failed.
The UV-curing lacquer had only a mention and has since dropped from view, which weakens commitment, but as a cheap consumable for the announced digital workflow it would likely be kept.
The intraoral contrast spray supports intraoral scanning, which is central to the firm's digital manufacturing direction, so weak visibility would be put down to temporary market conditions.
Custom earmolds rest on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing base and represent a multi-model investment, so management would persist.
Custom hearing protection shares the earmold production capabilities and serves a growing market, so disappointing results would be seen as market build-up time rather than failure.
